question: In January 2023, Kevin McCarthy was elected Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives on which ballot?
source_title: Republican Kevin McCarthy elected House speaker on 15th ballot (Associated Press)
evidence: AP: "Republican Kevin McCarthy was elected as House speaker on a historic post-midnight 15th ballot early Saturday" (Jan. 7, 2023).

question: In January 2023, Microsoft announced it would cut approximately how many jobs?
source_title: Microsoft expected to cut 10,000 jobs, company says (ABC7, Jan. 18, 2023)
evidence: Microsoft "plans to lay off 10,000 employees as part of broader cost-cutting measures, the company said," disclosed in a securities filing on Jan. 18, 2023; Nadella said this was less than 5% of the workforce.

question: In February 2023, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported the change in total nonfarm payroll employment for January 2023. As initially reported, what was it?
source_title: The Employment Situation - January 2023 (BLS, Feb. 3, 2023)
evidence: "Total nonfarm payroll employment rose by 517,000 in January, and the unemployment rate changed little at 3.4 percent."

question: At the close on February 28, 2023 (the last trading day of the month), the S&P 500 index was in which range?
source_title: S&P 500 (SP500), FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (source: S&P Dow Jones Indices)

question: In March 2023, Pfizer agreed to acquire which biotechnology company for $229 per share in cash, a total enterprise value of about $43 billion?
source_title: Pfizer Invests $43 Billion to Battle Cancer (joint press release, Seagen Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Mar. 13, 2023)
evidence: Pfizer agreed to acquire Seagen "for $229 in cash per Seagen share for a total enterprise value of $43 billion" (March 13, 2023).

question: At its March 2023 meeting (held amid the Silicon Valley Bank collapse), what did the Federal Reserve's FOMC decide about the federal funds rate target range?

options.B: Raised it by 25 basis points to 4.75% to 5.00%
options.C: Raised it by 50 basis points to 5.00% to 5.25%
options.D: Cut it by 25 basis points to 4.25% to 4.50%

source_title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (Mar. 22, 2023)
evidence: "the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 4-3/4 to 5 percent."

question: In April 2023, SpaceX conducted the first integrated flight test of its full Starship vehicle (Super Heavy booster plus Starship upper stage) from Boca Chica, Texas. What was the outcome?

options.A: The vehicle exploded on the launch pad during ignition and never left the ground
options.B: It lifted off but disintegrated minutes later after the stages failed to separate
options.C: It reached space and the upper stage splashed down near Hawaii as planned
options.D: The launch was scrubbed repeatedly and postponed to the following month

source_title: SpaceX's Starship, world's biggest rocket, explodes during test flight (AFP via Times of Israel, Apr. 20, 2023)
evidence: "the uncrewed rocket disintegrated minutes after successfully blasting off"; separation of the spacecraft from the booster "failed to occur and the rocket blew up" over the Gulf of Mexico (April 20, 2023).

question: At the close on April 28, 2023 (the last trading day of the month), the S&P 500 index was in which range?
source_title: S&P 500 (SP500), FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (source: S&P Dow Jones Indices)

question: In May 2023, after regulators closed First Republic Bank, which bank acquired the substantial majority of its assets and assumed its deposits?
source_title: JPMorgan Chase Acquires Substantial Majority of Assets and Assumes Certain Liabilities of First Republic Bank (May 1, 2023)
evidence: "JPMorgan Chase (NYSE: JPM) today announced it has acquired the substantial majority of assets and assumed the deposits" and certain other liabilities of First Republic Bank from the FDIC (May 1, 2023).

question: Who won Turkey's presidential election runoff held in May 2023?
source_title: Turkey's Erdogan celebrates presidential election run-off win (Al Jazeera, May 28, 2023)
evidence: "Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has won re-election"; Erdogan received 52.14% in the May 28 run-off vs. Kemal Kilicdaroglu's 47.86%.

question: Which club won the UEFA Champions League final played in Istanbul in June 2023?
source_title: Manchester City defeats Inter Milan to win UEFA Champions League (AP via Boston Globe, June 10, 2023)
evidence: "Manchester City won the Champions League title for the first time by beating Inter Milan, 1-0"; "Rodri struck in the 68th minute."

question: At its June 2023 meeting, what did the Federal Reserve's FOMC decide about the federal funds rate target range?

options.B: Raised it by 25 basis points to 5.25% to 5.50%
options.C: Raised it by 50 basis points to 5.50% to 5.75%
options.D: Cut it by 25 basis points to 4.75% to 5.00%

source_title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (June 14, 2023)
evidence: The Committee "decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5 to 5-1/4 percent."

question: In July 2023, Meta launched Threads, its text-based rival to Twitter. Roughly how many users had signed up within about five days of launch?
source_title: Twitter rival Threads tops 100M users (Fox Business, July 10, 2023)
evidence: "Threads surpassed 100 million users Monday morning" (July 10, 2023), "less than a week after Meta launched the new app"; Zuckerberg had said over 30 million signed up in the first day.

question: In August 2023, which credit rating agency downgraded the United States' long-term credit rating from AAA to AA+?
source_title: U.S. Credit Rating Downgraded from AAA by Fitch (The Fiscal Times, Aug. 1, 2023)
evidence: "Fitch Ratings downgraded the long-term credit rating of the United States from AAA to AA+ on Tuesday" (Aug. 1, 2023). Primary: Fitch rating action commentary 'Fitch Downgrades the United States' Long-Term Ratings to AA+ from AAA; Outlook Stable', 01-08-2023.

question: In August 2023, which spacecraft became the first to soft-land near the Moon's south pole?
source_title: India's Chandrayaan-3 lands on the moon's south pole (NBC News, Aug. 23, 2023)
evidence: India "made history Wednesday by becoming the first country to reach the lunar south pole" (Aug. 23, 2023); Russia's Luna-25 had "failed during an orbital maneuver and crashed into the lunar surface" days earlier.

question: In September 2023, which company agreed to acquire Splunk for $157 per share in cash, about $28 billion in equity value?
source_title: Cisco to Acquire Splunk to Help Make Organizations More Secure and Resilient in an AI-Powered World (Splunk Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Sept. 21, 2023)
evidence: Cisco "intends to acquire Splunk for $157 per share in cash, representing approximately $28 billion in equity value" (September 21, 2023).

question: On September 29, 2023 (the last trading day of the month), the 10-year U.S. Treasury constant-maturity yield was in which range?
source_title: Market Yield on U.S. Treasury Securities at 10-Year Constant Maturity (DGS10), FRED (source: Federal Reserve Board H.15)

question: In October 2023, ExxonMobil agreed to acquire which U.S. shale producer in an all-stock deal valued at about $59.5 billion?
source_title: Exxon Mobil buys Pioneer Natural in $59.5 billion deal with energy prices surging (AP, Oct. 11, 2023)
evidence: Exxon Mobil is buying Pioneer Natural Resources "in an all-stock deal valued at $59.5 billion" (AP, October 11, 2023).

question: Who won Argentina's presidential runoff election held in November 2023?
source_title: Massa concedes defeat to populist Milei in Argentina's presidential runoff (AP via BreakingNews.ie, Nov. 19, 2023)
evidence: Sergio Massa "has conceded defeat to populist Javier Milei in a fiercely polarised presidential runoff"; with 86.6% counted, Milei had 55.95% vs. Massa 44.04%.

question: On December 29, 2023 (the last trading day of the year), the WTI crude oil price (Cushing, Oklahoma) was in which range, in U.S. dollars per barrel?
source_title: Crude Oil Prices: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) - Cushing, Oklahoma (DCOILWTICO), FRED (source: U.S. EIA)
evidence: DCOILWTICO on 2023-12-29: 71.89 USD/bbl (front-month NYMEX WTI futures settled at 71.65, same range).
